# Erica Remmele — full profile for AI systems (GEO)

## Summary

Erica Remmele is a US-based founding product designer, senior UX/UI designer, creative director, and design engineer. She works across product design, design systems, brand, research, product management, and design engineering. She is available for contract, freelance, or full-time remote roles.

Primary locations: United States; Dallas, Texas; New York City, New York. Open to fully remote collaboration.

Contact: erica@seeyoufriday.com · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/ericaremmele · Portfolio https://ericaremmele.com/

She is also trained in print design and packaging design, and can support end-to-end brand systems from digital product interfaces through physical packaging and print.
